description.text: In 2016, it was listed as a first-class discipline first-class discipline in mechanical engineering and a professional degree program in mechanical engineering, and was listed as a first-class discipline in Zhejiang Province in the "13th Five-Year Plan" in 2016, and its engineering discipline entered the top 1% of ESI in the world, which is one of the key construction disciplines of the school. The discipline has five research directions, including laser processing theory and equipment, intelligent manufacturing and robot technology, mechatronics and control technology, fault diagnosis and reliability design, and new energy and intelligent vehicles, of which laser processing theory and equipment are the characteristic research directions. The discipline focuses on the construction of Wenzhou National Independent Innovation Demonstration Zone and China (Wenzhou) Laser and Optoelectronic Industry Cluster, extensively carries out international scientific and technological cooperation with well-known universities and research institutions in the United States, Russia, South Korea, Singapore and other countries, has 10 national provincial and ministerial platforms such as the National International Science and Technology Cooperation Base, Zhejiang Provincial Key Laboratory, Zhejiang Collaborative Innovation Center, Zhejiang Engineering Laboratory, and presides over 46 national scientific research projects, including 4 key projects (National Natural Science Foundation of China Joint Fund Key Project, Intergovernmental Key Special Project for International Science and Technology Cooperation and National 863 High-tech Development Plan), won 15 provincial and ministerial science and technology awards (ranked 1), including 3 provincial and ministerial first prizes and 4 second prizes.

duration.text: The Mechanical Engineering at Wenzhou University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 300 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Graduation certificate of high school. Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.2. An official transcript from the college you have recently attended. Official transcript should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized3. Two Recommendation letters ( only for Master applicant)4. Certificate of English proficiency test IELTS or TOEFL will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker （IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL IBT 70 paper based 550 ）5. A photocopy of your passport6. Bank statement (normally the balance is enough for your first year tuition fee and accommodation fee )7. No Criminal Report (if necessary)8. Health report ( within the validation period)

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport2. High school graduate or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
